tools.name: product-safety_cpsc-recall-search
tools.description: Search US CPSC recalls by keyword, firm, recall number, UPC or date range in the vendored snapshot. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/cpsc-recall-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: product-safety_eu-safety-gate-alert
tools.description: Search EU Safety Gate (RAPEX) non-food product alerts from vendored English weekly reports since 2024. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/eu-safety-gate-alert. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: product-safety_fsa-allergy-alert-search
tools.description: Search UK FSA allergy alerts, product recall information notices and food alerts for action. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/fsa-allergy-alert-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: product-safety_canada-health-recall-search
tools.description: Search Government of Canada Recalls and Safety Alerts open data in English or French. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/canada-health-recall-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: product-safety_usda-fooddata-nutrition
tools.description: Return nutrient values per 100 g from USDA FoodData Central Foundation Foods and SR Legacy. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/usda-fooddata-nutrition. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: product-safety_gs1-digital-link-parse
tools.description: Parse an uncompressed GS1 Digital Link URI into primary key, qualifiers and attributes; return canonical URI and element string. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/product-safety/gs1-digital-link-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "product-safety" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: product-safety_cpsc-recall-search, product-safety_eu-safety-gate-alert, product-safety_fsa-allergy-alert-search, product-safety_canada-health-recall-search · Public sink: product-safety_cpsc-recall-search, product-safety_eu-safety-gate-alert, product-safety_fsa-allergy-alert-search, product-safety_canada-health-recall-search, product-safety_usda-fooddata-nutrition, product-safety_gs1-digital-link-parse · Destructive: product-safety_cpsc-recall-search, product-safety_eu-safety-gate-alert, product-safety_fsa-allergy-alert-search, product-safety_canada-health-recall-search, product-safety_usda-fooddata-nutrition, product-safety_gs1-digital-link-parse.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
